name: real-timer
title: A real thread asks to be woken in two minutes, rests, and is woken by its timer
about: Real model calls (the cheapest model). The real Claude Code calls Neko's wake_me, ends its turn, the thread shows Waiting until …, and two minutes later it is resumed by its timer and answers. Only the real CLI can show the agent uses the tool as told.

steps.text: Do not change any files. Use Neko's wake_me tool to be woken in 2 minutes, end your turn now, and when you are woken reply with the single word hello.

steps.expect: The real agent sets a timer and the thread rests: Waiting until …

steps.name: waiting
steps.expect: The thread waiting on its timer
Two minutes later the timer wakes the thread and it answers

steps.name: woken
steps.expect: The thread after its timer woke it
